series.name: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)
series.notes: Older named-message scheme - no numbers, the message string itself is the code. Documented models are GW3648D-ES and GW5048D-ES (the D suffix means no DC switch; C suffix is the DC-switch variant, both marked FOR AUSTRALIA ONLY). The GoodWe SBP manual carries a near-identical named table (Utility Loss / VAC Failure / FAC Failure / Over Temperature / Relay Check Failure / DC Injection High / EEPROM R/W Failure / SPI Failure / DC Bus High / Back-Up Over Load); because the two tables are separate documents the SBP strings were not duplicated as their own series. Modern ES units sold in Pakistan (ES Uniq 8-12kW) run the SolarGo app and use the F-code or app-code schemes instead - treat this series as legacy.

title.ur: Utility Loss - grid power chala gaya

meaning.en: Public grid power is not available, or the on-grid connection has failed, so the inverter has shut down export.
meaning.ur: Public grid power mojood nahi ya on-grid connection fail ho gayi, is liye inverter ne export band kar diya.

causes.en: Inverter does not detect the connection of the grid.
causes.ur: Inverter grid ka connection detect nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, confirm AC side has voltage and grid power is available.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se confirm karein ke AC side par voltage hai aur grid power mojood hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC cables are connected tightly and well.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC cables tight aur theek se lage hain.

solutions.en: If all is well, turn the AC breaker off and back on after 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Agar sab theek hai to AC breaker band karke 5 minute baad dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

title.ur: VAC Failure - grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is outside the range required by the configured safety country, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Set hua safety country ki required range se grid voltage bahar hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: AC voltage beyond the normal range required by the safety country.
causes.ur: Safety country ki required normal range se AC voltage bahar hai.

causes.en: Safety country setting is wrong for the site.
causes.ur: Site ke liye safety country setting ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the safety country setting in the app matches the local grid standard.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke app mein safety country setting local grid standard se match karti hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage between L and N, and again on the AC breaker side, and compare.
solutions.ur: L aur N ke darmiyan AC voltage measure karein, phir AC breaker side par bhi, dono compare karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is high, check the AC cable size and run length against the manual.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage high ho to manual ke mutabiq AC cable size aur length check karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is low, check the AC connection and ensure the cable jacket is not crushed into the terminal.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage low ho to AC connection check karein aur cable ka jacket terminal mein na pasa ho.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

title.ur: FAC Failure - grid frequency range se bahar

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the range required by the safety country, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency safety country ki required range se bahar hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the normal range required by the safety country.
causes.ur: Grid frequency safety country ki normal required range se bahar hai.
Kabhi kabhi grid frequency unstable hoti hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the safety country setting is correct.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke safety country setting theek hai.

solutions.en: Read Fac on the inverter display and compare it with a clamp meter reading.
solutions.ur: Inverter display par Fac parhein aur clamp meter ki reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If FAC Failure appears only occasionally and clears, treat it as grid instability, not a fault.
solutions.ur: Agar FAC Failure sirf kabhi kabhi aaye aur clear ho jaye to isay grid instability samajhein, fault nahi.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

title.ur: Over Temperature - unit garm ho gaya

meaning.en: Internal inverter temperature is too high for the working environment, so the unit shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Working environment ke liye inverter ka internal temperature bohat zyada hai, is liye unit ne apne aap ko bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Working environment leads to a high internal temperature.
causes.ur: Working environment ki wajah se internal temperature high ho gaya.

causes.en: Indoor installation in a hot unventilated room or in direct sun.
causes.ur: Garm aur be-hawa room mein ya direct dhoop mein indoor installation.

solutions.en: Try to decrease the surrounding temperature - ventilate the room or shade the unit.
solutions.ur: Surrounding temperature kam karne ki koshish karein, room ventilate karein ya unit ko shadow dein.

solutions.en: Make sure the installation complies with the manual's clearance requirements.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke installation manual ki clearance requirements poora karta hai.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off for 15 minutes, then start it up again.
solutions.ur: Inverter 15 minute ke liye band karke dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

title.ur: Isolation Failure - insulation kam ho gayi

meaning.en: Ground insulation impedance of the PV string is too low, so the inverter's isolation monitor tripped.
meaning.ur: PV string ka ground insulation impedance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter ka isolation monitor trigger ho gaya.

causes.ur: PV panels theek se grounded nahi hain.

causes.en: PV panels are aged, or ambient humidity is comparatively heavy.
causes.ur: PV panels purane ho chuke hain ya ambient humidity bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check resistance between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to zero.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan resistance check karein, zero ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure resistance from PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- to earth and compare to the manual's minimum table.
solutions.ur: PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- se earth tak resistance measure karke manual ki minimum table se compare karein.

solutions.en: If below the minimum, disconnect strings one by one to find the leaking string and re-terminate its connectors.
solutions.ur: Agar minimum se neeche ho to strings ko aik aik disconnect karke leaking string dhoondein aur us ke connectors dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Note whether it only happens at dawn or in rain - high humidity alone can cause a legitimate trip.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke kya ye sirf fajr ya barsaat mein hota hai, sirf zyada humidity bhi asli trip karwa sakti hai.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

meaning.en: Ground leakage current is too high, usually because the AC side neutral and ground are not connected well.
meaning.ur: Ground leakage current bohat zyada hai, aam tor par is liye ke AC side neutral aur ground theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Neutral cable on the AC side is not connected well.
causes.ur: AC side ka neutral cable theek se nahi laga.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, measure voltage between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to 0V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan voltage measure karein, 0V ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If a voltage is present, re-terminate neutral and PE at the AC terminal block.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage maujood ho to AC terminal block par neutral aur PE dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: If it only occurs at dawn or in rain and recovers, that is normal humidity behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf fajr ya barsaat mein aaye aur theek ho jaye to ye normal humidity behaviour hai.
